title: Better than metal
text: Better than metal. I love this plastic lids for my mason jars. The 1st time I get to use them with the rubber ring. Easy to use, much better than metal

product_metadata.title: 12 Wide Mouth Plastic Mason Jar Lids and 12 Regular Mouth White Canning Lids with Silicone Seals Rings Fits Ball/Kerr Jars, Leak-Proof & Anti-Scratch Surface, 24 Pack
features: HIGH-QUALITY MATERIALS - These plastic mason jar lids are made of food-grade plastic, BPA free and 100% food safe grade that resists cracking and breaking, you can use it reliably. And the mason jar lid of the jar provides a strong seal to keep food for longer and won't get mouldy.

24 REGULAR & WIDE MOUTH MASON JAR LIDS - The regular mouth plastic mason jar lid fits 2.75 in (70mm) glass mason jars, and the wide mouth fits 3.38 in (86mm) mason jars. You will get 12 regular mouth jar lids+ 12 silicone rings and 12 wide mouth jar lids + 12 silicone rings.
FITS BALL, KERR AND MORE BRAND - Fits Ball or Kerr glass mason jars of any size. These canning lids are perfectly suited for canning storage and food preparation needs, ideal for storing or freezing
AIRTIGHT SEALING RINGS & SAFE STORAGE - The sealing gasket inside the canning jar lids makes the mason jar lids have good sealing performance keeping food, grains, dressings, drinks fresh.

100% SATISFACTION - If you have any questions about our mason jar lid set, send us a message in time, we will help you solve the problem on time. We do our best to ensure that each customer is satisfied with our products and services.
